description: This file defines route handlers for company-related API endpoints in a Node.js Express application, including listing companies, fetching company details, creating, and updating companies.

methods.name: GET /api/companies/
methods.description: Lists all companies with their job titles populated.

methods.name: GET /api/companies/:id
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific company by ID.

methods.name: POST /api/companies/
methods.description: Creates a new company, accessible only to an authenticated user with 'employer' role.

methods.name: PUT /api/companies/:id
methods.description: Updates existing company information, accessible only to an authenticated user with 'employer' role.
